monthly-housemaid.name: Monthly housemaid
monthly-housemaid.summary: A housemaid on a monthly contract in Riyadh — no recruitment paperwork and no long-term commitment.
monthly-housemaid.description: A monthly housemaid suits families in Riyadh who need daily help at home without going through recruitment and its costs. items.question: What is a monthly housemaid, and how is it different from recruitment?
items.answer: A monthly housemaid works for you on a monthly contract through the office, so you take on no recruitment process, no recruitment costs, and no visa or residency obligations. Recruitment means transferring a worker's sponsorship to you on a long-term contract. The monthly option is faster and more flexible, and can be renewed or ended month by month.

items.question: How much does a monthly housemaid cost in Riyadh?
items.answer: It depends on the service, the working hours and the size of the home. We tell you the monthly price and what it covers before anything is agreed, and you can ask for a quote on WhatsApp in minutes.

items.question: Can the worker be replaced if she is not the right fit?
items.answer: Yes. The replacement policy and its conditions are written into the contract before signing, so both sides know where they stand, and we handle replacement requests as quickly as we can.

items.question: Do you cover all districts of Riyadh?
items.answer: We cover most of Riyadh, north, south, east and west, including Al Olaya, Al Malqa, Al Narjis, Hittin, Al Yasmin, Qurtubah, Al Naseem and Al Suwaidi. Tell us your district and we will confirm.

items.question: Who is legally responsible for the worker?
items.answer: The worker is engaged through the office on a proper contract, and the office is the party responsible for her legal status. The contract sets out what falls to the office and what falls to you before anything starts.

items.question: How long before the worker starts?
items.answer: It depends on the service and availability. Visit-based cleaning can be arranged quickly, while a monthly housemaid needs time to match the request and prepare the contract. We give you an estimate at first contact.

aboutPage.metaDescription: How we work to provide monthly housemaids and domestic staff in Riyadh: a clear choice, proper contracts, and follow-up after the work starts.
story: We work in Riyadh as the link between families and the people who provide domestic help. Our job is to save you the searching and comparing: we listen to what you need, shortlist who fits, and prepare a clear monthly contract so the work starts without ambiguity.

Bringing someone into your home is a decision that belongs to the family, so we do not push to close an agreement and we do not send more candidates than you asked for. We tell you what we know about each worker, and what we do not, and leave the decision to you.
